title: Harden autonomy health and launch preflight
summary: Harden autonomy health diagnostics and launch preflight by adding typed helpers, config-backed autonomy policy, bounded diagnostic scans, non-blocking ActiveJobs review evidence, concurrency-safe growth snapshots, shared launch intent normalization, and opt-in encoder capability refresh.
reason: Autonomy health and launch preflight needed safer evidence handling and less surprising launch-readiness behavior: stale worker evidence should be visible without blocking launches, and read-only preflight should not refresh encoder capability evidence unless explicitly requested.
behavior_before: Launch preflight could refresh encoder capability evidence as part of a normal read, preflight and start request parsing had separate normalization paths, ActiveJobs stale/malformed evidence was treated as ready or could fail the payload, diagnostic scans could over-enumerate details, nested roots could be double-counted in growth bytes, and growth snapshot writes had no diagnostics-local lock.
behavior_after: Launch preflight is read-only by default and refreshes encoder capability evidence only when refresh_encoder_capability_report=true is requested. Preflight and start share launch-intent normalization. Autonomy categories use typed builders, config-backed defaults, bounded scans, per-category review evidence on read/stat/JSON errors, non-blocking worker review for stale/malformed ActiveJobs evidence, unique observed byte accounting, capped watchdog records, and locked growth snapshot writes.
